name: ewoh-workbench-large-data
description: Large-data performance budget for the Role Workbench (Task 7). Evaluated against a REAL PostgreSQL test DB populated by scripts/perf/seed-workbench-data.js.

dataScale.note: The gate FAILS (not warns) if the seeded schedule_task row count is below this. --scale 100000 is the production-mirror large run; --scale 1000000 available via flag.

nPlusOne.note: A single list query must issue exactly 2 statements (accurate COUNT + data SELECT). More than 2 on a per-item basis indicates N+1.

fullTableScanPerRefresh.note: Dashboard/list refresh must not seq-scan the workbench source tables (org_id + predicate indexes must be used).

orgIsolation.note: org-a scoped queries must never return org-b / org-c rows.
